title: Have and Get Something Done
summary: Learn how to use 'have' and 'get something done' when we pay other people to do work for us. You will be able to talk about haircuts, repairs, and professional services easily.

sections.p: We use 'have something done' or 'get something done' when we do not do something ourselves. Instead, we pay or ask another person, like a professional, to do it for us. The structure is: subject + have/get + object + past participle (V3). For example, you do not cut your own hair; you let a hairdresser do it.

ex.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
ex.mean: A hairdresser cut my hair for me.

ex.en: She is getting her car repaired tomorrow.
ex.mean: A mechanic will fix her car.

sections.p: Both 'have something done' and 'get something done' mean the exact same thing. However, 'get something done' is usually a little more informal and is very common in everyday spoken English. 'Have something done' can sound slightly more formal or traditional, but native speakers use both all the time.

ex.en: We need to have our roof fixed before winter.
ex.mean: We need workers to repair our roof.

ex.en: I need to get my passport renewed soon.
ex.mean: I need official people to give me a new passport.

sections.p: You can change the verb 'have' or 'get' into any tense you need. You can use it in the past, the future, with modal verbs, or in the present continuous. Remember that the main action at the end always stays in the past participle form (V3).

ex.en: He has his groceries delivered every week.
ex.mean: A delivery person brings his food weekly.

ex.en: They will have their house painted next month.
ex.mean: Painters are going to paint their house.

tip: Think of a service you pay for every month, like a haircut or a dental check-up. Make a real sentence about it using 'I have my...' to remember the pattern.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence
quiz.en: I usually ___ my hair cut at the new salon downtown.
She is getting her laptop ___ right now because it broke.

quiz.ask: Select the correct sentence for this situation: A painter painted our house yesterday.

quiz.en: You should ___ your eyes tested this week.
What does 'I am having my car washed' mean?
choices: I am washing my car by myself.
I am paying someone to wash my car.
I want to buy a new car.

quiz.en: They will ___ their photos printed tomorrow.
